retrievalProfile.description: A framed urban scene viewed through an open white door, featuring a couple in a candid embrace with bold, stacked slab-serif typography on the door panel.
triggerTerms: vintage album cover with stacked slab serif

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition where an open white paneled door acts as a secondary frame for a couple embracing in a wintery urban setting, with text integrated directly onto the door's surface.
coreVisualRelationships: The door frame creates a literal 'inside/outside' spatial dichotomy.
The couple's embrace provides a soft emotional center against the rigid geometry of the door.
Typography is anchored to the vertical axis of the door panel, creating a column of information.
coreInvariants: Open white paneled door as a right-side foreground element
Winter urban background with bare trees and iron fencing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The couple is positioned in the left two-thirds of the frame, medium-full shot scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical edge of the open door and the brass hardware.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the couple's embrace, move right to the bold title text, then down the tracklist on the door panel.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The white surface of the door provides functional negative space for typographic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and muted greys from the door and urban background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the couple's clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted orange-red in the woman's coat and purple-pink in the title text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white door and dark clothing.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or high-chroma digital colors

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with high x-height and tight spacing.
letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight with slight modulation
Tight kerning for a compact, impactful look
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy slab serif for impact paired with a clean, condensed sans-serif for legibility in lists.
graphicDevices: Horizontal bars framing technical metadata at the top
Square logo placement in the center of the door panel

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, blocky slab serif aesthetic of the title.
Appropriate for the secondary list text to maintain a mid-century feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a couple in a winter embrace, seen through the frame of an open white paneled door on the right. The background should show a 1960s urban street with bare trees and an iron fence.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, stacked slab-serif title text in the upper panel of the door using orange and purple. Add a list of text in a condensed blue sans-serif in the lower panel of the door.

verificationChecks: Is the door acting as a frame for the couple?
Is the title text heavy slab-serif and stacked?
Is the color palette muted with specific pops of orange and purple?
Is the photography style grainy and film-like?

mustAchieve: Integrated typography that feels part of the door surface
avoid: Floating text that doesn't respect the door's perspective

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the door hardware (knob/latch) is visible and realistic.
Check that the text follows the slight perspective of the open door.
Verify the couple's pose feels candid rather than staged.
Confirm the color of the title text is distinct from the background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Frame a [Subject] through an [Architectural Element] on the right, using the [Architectural Element] as a canvas for [Heavy Slab Serif] typography in a [Vintage Film] style.
